Calculation: Sum months within each location-year; average period totals across years.
Scope and limits: Selected months and years; each location is a grid-cell sample.

Calculation: 100 × (rainfall − same-month reference mean) / reference mean.
Scope and limits: 2015–2019 reference; undefined for a zero reference mean.

Calculation: (rainfall − same-month reference mean) / sample reference standard deviation.
Scope and limits: Short reference period; this is not SPI.

Calculation: 100 × count(rainfall < same-month reference mean) / eligible months.
Scope and limits: Exploratory frequency; no official drought threshold.

Calculation: 100 × sum(the three largest monthly totals) / full-year rainfall; average across complete years.
Scope and limits: Monthly concentration, not daily rainfall intensity; zero-rain years are undefined.

Calculation: 100 × sample standard deviation of complete annual totals / mean annual total.
Scope and limits: At least two complete years and positive mean rainfall; descriptive variability.

Calculation: Sum October–September rainfall, labeled by the ending year.
Scope and limits: Use is_complete=true for comparisons; boundary years are incomplete.

Calculation: Sum(cell rainfall × cos(latitude)) / sum(cos(latitude)).
Scope and limits: Geofabrik extract footprint; independent of the twelve sample locations.

Calculation: OLS slope of ten complete annual rainfall totals against year.
Scope and limits: 2015–2024; descriptive slope without significance tests or forecasts.

Calculation: Sum(monthly temperature × hourly count) / sum(hourly count).
Scope and limits: 2 m modeled temperature; weight by hours within each location.

Calculation: Monthly mean temperature − same-month 2015–2019 reference temperature.
Scope and limits: The reference temperature is hour-weighted.

Calculation: 100 × count(temperature > same-month reference) / eligible months.
Scope and limits: Monthly means; does not measure hot days or heatwaves.

Calculation: 10 × OLS slope of hour-weighted annual mean temperature against year.
Scope and limits: Ten-year exploratory slope, not an attribution or projection.

Calculation: 100 × hour-weighted mean of soil_moisture.
Scope and limits: Modeled volumetric moisture at 0–7 cm; not groundwater or reservoir storage.

Calculation: 100 × (soil_moisture − same-month reference moisture).
Scope and limits: Percentage-point difference, not percentage change.

Calculation: 100 × count(soil_moisture < same-month reference) / eligible months.
Scope and limits: Exploratory surface-moisture condition, not agricultural drought classification.

Calculation: 100 × count(rainfall < reference AND temperature > reference) / eligible months.
Scope and limits: Both comparisons use the same calendar month at the same location; no causal claim.

Calculation: Mapped water-service objects within 20 km of each sample location.
Scope and limits: Contemporary OSM context; not supply, storage volume or service capacity.

Calculation: Mapped healthcare-service objects within 20 km.
Scope and limits: Mapping completeness varies; counts are not hospital beds or accessibility.

Calculation: Mapped education-service objects within 20 km.
Scope and limits: Counts are not enrollment or educational outcomes.

Calculation: Sum road-segment lengths whose midpoint lies within 20 km.
Scope and limits: Approximate neighborhood context; no exact clipping or road-capacity claim.

Calculation: Count distinct osm_id values among selected location memberships.
Scope and limits: Deduplicate overlapping neighborhoods; do not sum overlapping location counts.

Calculation: 100 × observed unique location-month keys / expected keys.
Scope and limits: The published dataset has twelve samples × 120 months; not national coverage.

Calculation: 100 × observed hours / leap-year-aware expected monthly hours.
Scope and limits: Source completeness is not measurement accuracy.
